label: Law determination controls checked
description: Structural determination of a probability law without an agent: one symmetry orbit, or positive binary switching, fixes a unique law; two orbits, zero switching or an idle upper mixture leave it open. Uniqueness is not convergence (the flip kernel's point-mass orbit never reaches its unique stationary law). Generalizes #2144's exchange-symmetry control. Mathematics only: no claim that a source has such a structure, and no defeat of either the impersonal or the personal account. Not a transcription; establishes no premise.
